ideas.title: Petrified Guardian
ideas.description:
This new boss (will only spawn in the new crystal hollows cave biome [Only in flooded variant {In a new crystal temple structure}]). The new boss will have 3 phases:
- Phase 1: The Petrified guardian will have a tough rocky exterior which is immune to all damage types. The Petrified guardian can only be damaged by piercing damage and only when the damage hits the "eye" of the guardian it will deal damage. After the boss has taken 100 damage, it will move on to phase 2.
- Phase 2: The Petrified guardian's "shell" will break off revealing a crystalline structure with 8 guardian "eyes" on every side in this stage the 4 or 6 of the eyes will be active and can only be damaged with soul type damage. The name will change from "Petrified guardian" to "Crystalized guardian". When the Crystalized guardian takes 250 damage, it will move on to phase 3.

(Note I think U guys don't understand what soul does so don't approve or disapprove of this because it is a reminder)

- Soul breach (Enchant only usable on axes and maces)[When 100 soul is used shoots 25 souls upward from the attack dealing 2 damage each]
- Soul strike (Enchant only usable on swords, daggers, tridents, and spears)[When 100 soul is used causes the next attack to deal 150% damage and shoots 5 soul horizontally dealing 5 damage each)
- Soul shot (Enchant only for bows and crossbows) [When 100 soul is used shoots an arrow that deals 200% damage and causes soul fire to envelop the enemy]
- Soul siphon I (Enchant for any weapon) [gives 5x the soul per kill]
- Soul siphon II [Gives 10x soul per kill]
- Soul siphon III [Gives 25x soul per kill]
- Amulet of revenge [Requires 500 soul to activate]
- Bone dagger lifesteal
*X means amount not multiplication
All these things deal soul damage which can be used on specific mobs to deal insane damage. These things all require different amounts of soul mining shridnite ore will give the player 20 soul per block mined (this is only the first time the block is broken). The player can also brush soul sand to convert it into soul soil and gives the player 10 soul.

ideas.author: Aadi
ideas.title: End City Upgrades
ideas.description:
End City Upgrades:
- Loom room - contains banners, looms, chests with wool and dye, and a custom banner pattern in an item frame (the pattern is the same as the banners all around the city)
- Chill room - contains couches and cushions and also a clock and a compass.
- Housing unit - contains four bridges to houses
- Small house - contains a chest and a brewing stand with potions, a seat, and a small porch.
- Large house - contains a chest, ender chest, long seat, a porch, and a shulker guard "Sentry"
- Reactor room - contains nuclear banner signs, and a radonite beacon pyramid that has blocks missing. Echowood sign says 'WARNING' in yellow text. A splash potion of jump boost is contained in an item frame. The player can also use pistons at the bottom to remotely repair the reactor. The beacon is absent; the player must obtain it themselves.
- Terrace farm/farm room - Inside this large room is a chest, multiple composters, and a farm. The farm contains fully grown melon stalks and wheat. On the roof is endstone and endsoil, with chorus fruit and endilary on it. (read next)
- Material-smithing room: Contains a crucible that is filled with radonite and a chest with redstone, gold, and even a few diamonds. Only place to get Chorine upgrade template.
- Tool-smithing room: Contains many blast furnaces and smithing tables and a chest with iron, gold, diamonds. Also contains a crystallurgy area with diamond crystals nearby.
- Library: Contains bookshelves with an enchanting setup, as well as chiseled bookshelves with enchanted books, anvil, and grindstone.
- Intersection: Common room with four bridges and open-sky layout. Sometimes contains an ender chest
- Target room: Fletching tables and targets
- Cartography room: The cartography room will be an End equivalent of this room with yellow and black carpet, and a lodestone compass that leads to the End Citadel
- Stasis room: Contains multiple stasis chambers. Empty. (Or should they be filled? Hmmm...)

discussions.title: Eric’s reasons why antennas and receivers suck

posts.author: Eric
posts.text: Attenaes and receivers should not be added because these items defeat the purpose of redstone. Redstone is supposed to encourage creativity via having the player perform advanced problem solving, but block that are too “advanced” like these would cause redstoners to become lazier. On the surface, these blocks may sound like a way to make life easier, but they really just phase out creative methods of remote powering such as bud switching or calibrated sculk sensors. Another reason why attenaes and receivers suck is because the advanced technological feeling given by these blocks do not fit the medieval voxel survival game vibe in minecraft.
